items.hook: Last Ditch is a detective novel by Ngaio Marsh; it is the twenty-ninth novel to feature Roderick Alleyn, and was first published in 1977.
items.body: The plot concerns drug smuggling in the Channel Islands, and features Alleyn's son, Ricky, in a central role. One of those things you can't un-know.

items.hook: Nat Turner leads black slaves and free blacks in a rebellion in Southampton County, Virginia, which will claim the lives of 55 to 65 whites and about twice that number of blacks.
items.body: Nat Turner was an enslaved Black carpenter and preacher who led a four-day rebellion of both slave and free Black people in Southampton County, Virginia, in August 1831. Worth a quiet trip down the rabbit hole.
